chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abi Baseer, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:
Marrying the Jewish woman and the Christian woman is preferable, or he said: better than marrying the Nasibi (Hostile one) and the Nasibiyyah (Hostile woman).

key_terms.النَّاصِبِ: the Nasibi (one hostile to the Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.النَّاصِبِيَّةِ: the Nasibiyyah (female hostile to the Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: Is it better to marry a Christian woman or a Nasibi woman according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a comparative ruling where marrying a Jewish or Christian woman is superior to marrying a 'Nasibi' (one hostile to the Ahl al-Bayt), even if the latter is Muslim. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on theological alignment and proximity to the Ahl al-Bayt over mere religious affiliation, prioritizing those with fewer doctrinal conflicts regarding the Imams. The ruling underscores that enmity to the Prophet's family constitutes a significant spiritual detriment, potentially outweighing the minor differences with People of the Book.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Marrying the Jewish woman and the Christian woman is preferable’, or said: ‘better than marrying the Hostile man (Nasibi) and the Hostile (Nasibi) woman’.
en.sarwar: 16. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ali ibn abu Hamzah from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Marriage with a Jewish or Christian women is preferable’ - or He (the Imam) said that it is better- ‘than marriage with al-Nasibah (people hostile to ‘A’immah).”’
